entities.name: Kami
entities.description: The great spirits associated with all things in Kamigawa, of overwhelming variety, led by the five myojin and rivaled only by O-Kagachi.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of the kami, the Kami War and the Neon Dynasty.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: The great kami of all things, manifest as an immense eight-headed serpent; his scion's theft started the Kami War.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The child of O-Kagachi, imprisoned by the daimyo Konda.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: The daimyo who imprisoned Kyodai.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war on Kamigawa that began when O-Kagachi's scion was stolen.

entities.name: Myojin
entities.description: The five greatest kami; the Myojin of Life's Web had Michiko captured, hoping to end the war.

entities.name: Michiko
entities.description: A princess whom the Myojin of Life's Web had captured and who escaped.

entities.name: Yosei
entities.description: The dragon spirit that protected Eiganjo, ripped apart fighting O-Kagachi; reborn as Ao, the Dawn Sky.

entities.name: Keiga
entities.description: The dragon spirit that protected Minamo, killed by Hidetsugu; reborn as Kairi, the Swirling Sky.

entities.name: Kokusho
entities.description: The dragon spirit guardian of the Takenuma swamp; reborn as Junji, the Midnight Sky.

entities.name: Ryusei
entities.description: The dragon spirit guardian of the Sokenzan mountains; reborn as Atsushi, the Blazing Sky.

entities.name: Jugan
entities.description: The dragon spirit protector of Jukai forest, summoned in the war; reborn as Kura, the Boundless Sky.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: A figure who killed Keiga with his yamabushi and was consumed and fused with the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.

entities.name: Oni
entities.description: Bloodthirsty demon kami bent on destruction, released in the aftermath of Boseiju's destruction.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: A sacred place whose destruction in the New Phyrexian Invasion killed many kami.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: The modern city whose growth threatens the kami.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: A tanuki-form spirit who became Kaito Shizuki's partner and ignited his spark.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker whose spark Himoto ignited.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who killed kami en masse.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that destroyed Boseiju and killed many kami.

events.summary: The theft of O-Kagachi's scion starts the Kami War.
events.quote: It was because the theft of O-Kagachi's scion, that the Kami War began.

events.summary: The Myojin of Life's Web has Michiko captured hoping her death would end the war; the princess escapes and the forest is attacked by the Moonfolk of Oboro.
events.quote: She had Michiko captured, hoping that her death would end the Kami War.

events.summary: Yosei is ripped apart in battle against O-Kagachi but survives to help Eiganjo's refugees.
events.quote: He was ripped-apart in the battle against O-Kagachi, but survived and helped the Eiganjoan refugees in the battle against the hordes of the Myojin of Infinite Rage.

events.summary: Hidetsugu and his yamabushi kill Keiga during their attack on the Minamo school.
events.quote: She was killed by Hidetsugu and his yamabushi minions during their attack on the school.

events.summary: Jugan is summoned by the monks of the Order of the Sacred Bell to fight in the Battle of Silk and is killed.
events.quote: In the initial stages of the war, he was summoned by the monks of the Order of the Sacred Bell to fight in the Battle of Silk .

events.summary: The Phyrexians kill kami en masse.
events.quote: As they have no flesh to be compleated, they were killed en masse by the Phyrexians.

events.summary: About 1200 years after the Kami War, the kami are threatened by the growth of Towashi.
events.quote: About 1200 years after the Kami War the kami are threatened by the growth of the modern city of Towashi.

events.summary: The destruction of Boseiju in the New Phyrexian Invasion kills many kami.
events.quote: With the New Phyrexian Invasion , the destruction of Boseiju caused the death of many kami.

events.summary: Oni are released in the aftermath, terrorising the plane.
events.quote: Oni were released in the aftermath, terrorising the plane.

events.summary: More than 1200 years after the Kami War the dragon spirits are reborn.
events.quote: More than 1200 years after the Kami War , the dragons have been reborn and continue to be the protectors of Kamigiwa.

relations.note: Kyodai is the child of O-Kagachi.
relations.quote: Kyodai / That Which Was Taken , the child of O-Kagachi, imprisoned by the daimyo Konda
